qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Unmatched commercial narrowbody backlog (A320neo family) with over 8,500 aircraft on order provides commanding commercial aircraft pricing power.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 6 (Rejected – G6 Cash & Fortress Balance Sheet). Global commercial aircraft duopolist with decade-long backlog, but fails peak-to-peak business cycle compounding (2024 EPS of €5.36 remains below 2018 peak of €5.80+) alongside chronic supply-chain working capital volatility and recurring defense/space contract write-downs.
qualitative.evidence: Commercial backlog exceeds 8,500 aircraft, but 2018 peak EPS of €5.80 remains unexceeded in 2024 (€5.36). Defence & Space charges (€1.3B in 2024) and inventory gliders from CFM/Spirit supplier bottlenecks impair through-cycle cash conversion.

evaluation_metadata.verdict: Rejected – G6 Cash & Fortress Balance Sheet
